parameter_head_inputs: genotype embedding (4), observed scaled prefix lengths (4), prefix presence masks (4)
initialization: Preserve genotype weights and all core initialization; new prefix/mask columns start at zero.
mask_seed_rule: 20260910 + training seed; unchanged paired masks from the preceding benchmark
candidate_selection: Lowest mean actual 48-h validation RMSE over all three seeds under natural missingness; ties favor smaller lambda_ode.
missingness_protocol: Transfer the natural-missingness validation-selected coefficient unchanged to both additional-removal conditions and retrain PhytoODE only.
test_policy: Candidates save train/validation results only. Freeze the selected coefficient and all nine checkpoint hashes before evaluating any test targets.
scope: Only the PhytoODE parameter head and capacity coefficient change; other architecture, data protocol, illumination, training schedule, and baselines are retained. Only lambda_ode is searched.
